text:
“Why is there such rage in my heart,” you ask,
and such a defiant head on my supple neck?
Because I come from the race of Antaeus
and turn the victor god’s arrows back.

I am one of those the Avenger inspires;
he marked my brow with his angry mouth.
Beneath Abel’s pallor, stained with blood,
I sometimes bear Cain’s relentless blush!

Jehovah, he who, conquered by your genius,
last of all cried from hell’s depths, “O tyranny!”
is my grandfather Belus, or my father Dagon…

Three times I was bathed in Cocytus’ waters;
sole protector of my Amalekite mother,
I sow the old dragon’s teeth at her feet.

translation.title: Anteros
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
